# varnish_cdn_purge_token (Resource)

A purge token: a long-lived credential that may only invalidate cached content. The token itself is returned once, when it is created, and is stored in the Terraform state. Changing any argument issues a new token and revokes the old one.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A purge token can only invalidate cached content, nothing else.
resource "varnish_cdn_purge_token" "ci" {
  label  = "ci-pipeline"
  expire = "8760h" # one year
}

# Optional: also allow HTTP basic auth against the purge endpoint.
resource "varnish_cdn_purge_token" "legacy" {
  label          = "legacy-cms"
  basic_username = "cms"
  basic_secret   = var.cms_purge_secret
}

output "ci_purge_token" {
  value     = varnish_cdn_purge_token.ci.access_token
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `label` (String) Name shown for the token in the UI and API.

### Optional

- `basic_secret` (String, Sensitive) Password for basic_username. Must be set together with basic_username.
- `basic_username` (String) Username for HTTP basic auth against the purge endpoint, as an alternative to the bearer token. Must be set together with basic_secret.
- `expire` (String) Lifetime as a Go duration, for example "8760h" for a year. Defaults to the organization's access token TTL. The API never returns it, so an imported token has no expire in state: setting it in config then replaces that token on the next apply.

### Read-Only

- `access_token` (String, Sensitive) Bearer token used to purge. Null on an imported token: the API never returns it again.
- `access_token_expires_at` (String) Expiry of access_token, RFC3339. Null on an imported token.
- `expires_at` (String) When the token stops working, RFC3339.
- `id` (String) Token identifier.
- `org_id` (String) Organization the token belongs to.
- `refresh_token` (String, Sensitive) Refresh token issued alongside the access token. Null on an imported token.
- `refresh_token_expires_at` (String) Expiry of refresh_token, RFC3339. Null on an imported token.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = varnish_cdn_purge_token.ci
  identity = {
    id = "12"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) Server-assigned identifier, the same value as the id attribute.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Purge tokens are imported by their token ID.
# An imported token has no access_token. Setting "expire" in config replaces
# the token on the next apply.
terraform import varnish_cdn_purge_token.ci 12
```
